<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
<td class="text">The first part (the &#8220;Investment Income Incentive Fee&#8221;) will be calculated and payable on a quarterly basis, in arrears, and will equal 12.5% of &#8220;pre-Incentive Fee net investment income&#8221; for the immediately preceding calendar quarter, subject to a quarterly preferred return of 1.25% (i.e., 5.0% annualized) (the &#8220;Hurdle Rate&#8221;) measured on a quarterly basis with a &#8220;catch-up&#8221; feature<span></span>
</td>
